title: PBA: Burton sees a different side of Alapag after NLEX’s slow start

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX import Deonte Burton admitted that it was his first time seeing coach Jimmy Alapag lose a bit of his usual calm and collected manner after the Road Warriors went through some rough patches before cruising past the Titan Ultra Giant Risers, 147-115, on Wednesday in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. “This is my first time to like really seeing him like that,” Burton said. “So it’s good to see another side of him, even if he’s mad.” READ: PBA: ‘Don’t play with the game,’ Jimmy Alapag reminds NLEX Alapag was not pleased with how NLEX started flat against a […]...
